title: Ankhorage EAS Deployment Provider
summary: Provides an EAS deployment provider for Ankhorage application shipment.
purpose: Isolate Expo Application Services deployment behavior behind a provider boundary.
responsibilities: Provide the EAS deployment provider composition.
Adapt EAS-specific deployment behavior to the deployment-provider boundary.
boundaries: Does not own deployment orchestration or cross-provider release policy.
Does not implement Google Play or App Store Connect deployment providers.
audience: Applications and deployment tooling that select an EAS provider.

architecture.role: An outbound deployment-provider adapter with an explicit composition entrypoint.
invariants: EAS-specific behavior remains behind the provider boundary.
